title: Choose and justify a common denominator

blocks.title: Recall two valid denominators
blocks.instructions: Compare two representations of the same fraction and explain their equal value.

blocks.title: Justify a denominator choice
blocks.instructions: Model two valid common denominators for a fresh sum. Explain why the smaller convenient denominator is optional.

blocks.title: Compare methods in pairs
blocks.instructions: Solve fresh sums using two valid methods. Explain why equivalent unreduced results count as correct.

blocks.title: Apply the chosen method
blocks.instructions: Solve short ribbon-length problems with working and units. The teacher records help without supplying a group label.

blocks.title: Check the reasoning
blocks.instructions: Write one equivalent-fraction step and explain what the denominator counts.
